title: 阪神JFの後に・Oh！パールファミリー

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! See? I knew it. You don't need to be from a famous family to win.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We can all shake hands with anyone we'd like! Bonds are something that can be fostered and grown. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl runs well against Mejiro Dober and proves her potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That was a great race, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family is my pride and joy. I think it's wonderful, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see you, too, share deep bonds with people who are just as close as family to you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I suppose that's another form of family in and of itself. Your family is stupendous as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My family?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Why are you saying that like you're some kind of outsider? You're part of my family too, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? I am?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! I'd never be so petty as to turn away someone just because they're part of another Umamusume family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Everyone's welcome! I don't care if you're already part of another family! One day, everyone in the world will be part of mine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Welcome to the Pearl family, Mejiro Dober! I dub thee family member number two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The Pearl family, you say… And I'm its second addition?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haha. I'm a bit upset I wasn't the first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Sorry, but that spot's long been booked.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's reserved for the person who believed in my possibilities and wanted to share them with the world. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl looks at me and winks. And with that, the curtains fall on both her junior year and her fierce battle with the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. That went just as planned. We shouldn't have any problems growing the Pearl family going forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was it not? Oh well! Think of it as a side quest as we take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With Dober as member number two and Bright as member number three, my family just keeps getting bigger…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And now that I have a sizable family, there's only one thing to do next year.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Do you even have to ask? We need to go see the cherry blossoms together! Let's go see them when they're in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And by that, I mean we take on the Oka Sho! That's not a problem, is it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho. It measures 1,600 meters and is the first race of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see no issues with the difficulty or distance of the race. In fact, it's close to being the most ideal race Seeking the Pearl can run.
choice_data_list: It's no problem at all! All right! The Oka Sho it is!
It's no problem at all! All right! The Oka Sho it is!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer! Let's keep showing the world more of my limitless possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My classic year will be the runway leading out to the big, wide world, and I'm planning to sprint down it with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!
